name: Introduction and overview — Harrier II — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Harrier II
description: Introduction and overview of the Harrier II: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Harrier II is a single-engine V/STOL attack aircraft built by McDonnell Douglas and British Aerospace, entering service in 1985. Its vectored-thrust Pegasus engine lets it take off vertically and hover. About 340 were built; U.S. Marine Corps AV-8B Harrier IIs flew from amphibious ships until F-35B replacement. Baseline facts: V/STOL attack aircraft; service from 1985; ~340 built; vertical takeoff and hover capable..
